summary: Solid Biosciences Inc. filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, disclosing the filing of a prospectus supplement under its existing S-3 shelf registration statement to offer and sell up to $200.0 million of common stock via an Amended and Restated Sales Agreement with Jefferies LLC. The previous $85.0 million offering under that agreement was fully exhausted, and the new supplement replaces it. This is a routine ATM equity offering, not a special situation. No special-situation elements such as a merger, tender, or restructuring are present. The filing includes a legal opinion from Wilmer Cutler Pickering Hale and Dorr LLP. This is an ordinary capital-raising under an established shelf facility.
